topic: Retail i76.exe native VCF GEO construction, TMT object binding and body-cache variant switching
summary: Continues the unmerged prior v2.3.0 original-code VCF experiment under its reserved run identity. Original native 00449680/TMT decoder/owner slot registration runs for 46 TMT references, 004469A0/00446C90 constructs 8 GEO payloads and 004466C0 switches two stock body meshes and reuses the first cached handle. Two separate original-instruction top-level VCF executions retained. Does not replace legacy data or promote findings.
